title: [29.x]-Validation of the "No." field on the sales order additionally re-validates the Unit of Measure Code
summary: Fixed a bug where validating the "No." field on a sales order with a linked released production order caused repeated production order status warnings and potential modal dialog errors in write transactions.
key_points: Wrapped Unit of Measure Code validation with StatusCheckSuspended flag to prevent nested status checks
Added StatusCheckSuspended guard in Quantity and Shipment Date validations before calling CheckReceiptOrderStatus
Ensured production order status warning executes only once during initial "No." field validation
Applied fix across all localization layers and added comprehensive test coverage
Prevents 'Form.RunModal is not allowed in write transactions' error
quote: Validation of the "No." field on the sales order additionally re-validates the Unit of Measure Code
